slides.heading: Reception — Autumn 2, Week 4
slides.sub: New sounds taught directly, practised and applied in words, captions and the matching decodable book.

slides.heading: Mon
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "j" (/dʒ/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="jug" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="jug"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Jem the ladybird jiggles and jumps, j-j-j, every time she lands on a leaf.

character.name: Jem
character.blurb: Jem is a small ladybird who can't stand still — she jiggles her wings before every little jump.

slides.pronunciation_note: Pure sound only, e.g. 'j-j-j' not 'juh' — keep it short and bouncy, no vowel on the end.
slides.formation_cue: Start at the top of the small letters. Pull straight down below the line and curl round to the left. Finish below the line. Lift, and add a dot above.
slides.formation_rhyme: Straight down, curl under, dot up high.
slides.action: Give two quick jiggling jumps on the spot, elbows tucked in, saying j-j-j as you land each time.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="jug" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="jug"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.tip: Once you know 'in' and 'to', you already know 'into' — just listen for the o at the end saying 'oo', not its short sound.

slides.heading: Tue
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "v" (/v/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="van" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="van"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Vela the vole feels her whiskers vibrate, vvv, whenever she trundles her tiny cart of seeds.

character.name: Vela
character.blurb: Vela is a round little hedgehog who pulls a cart everywhere, whiskers buzzing as the wheels turn.

slides.pronunciation_note: A buzzy, continuous sound — top teeth rest gently on bottom lip and you can hold it, 'vvvv', don't add 'uh'.
slides.formation_cue: Start at the top left of the small letters. Slant down to a point on the line, then slant up to the right. Finish at the top right.
slides.formation_rhyme: Down to a point, up and out.
slides.action: Rest two fingers lightly on your chin and let them 'buzz' while you hum vvv.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="van" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="van"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.heading: Wed
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "w" (/w/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="web" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="web"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Willow the wren wobbles side to side along her branch, w-w-w, before she takes off.

character.name: Willow
character.blurb: Willow is a small wren who never flies straight off — she wobbles a wiggly little dance on the branch first.

slides.pronunciation_note: Round your lips into a small circle before you start, then open them as you say 'w' — quick and rounded, not stretched.
slides.formation_cue: Start at the top left of the small letters. Slant down to a point, up to the middle, down to a second point, then up. Finish at the top right.
slides.formation_rhyme: Two valleys, each one rising up.
slides.action: Round your lips into a circle, sway your shoulders side to side twice, then say w-w-w.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="web" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="web"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.heading: Thu
slides.objective: Extra practice blending and segmenting everything taught this week — no new content today.

slides.heading: Fri
slides.objective: Revisit everything taught this week, read the matched decodable book, and check how securely it has been learned.
